title: Phase Seven - Eight
subtitle: Test your grasp of Phase Seven - Eight — E.B.S. truth packages, Whitehat media takeover, Truth Tribunals, and overt liberation of the realm.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Phase Seven - Eight is the culmination of The Great Purge: E.B.S. shatters the 3D illusion, then tribunals and realm security stabilize the aftermath. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Phase Seven - Eight deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Covert neutralization becomes overt liberation—and the realm is secured for crystalline reconstruction and Ascension.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Phase Seven - Eight deep-dive

questions.question: What do Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent in The Great Purge?

options.label: A
options.text: Only permanent Narrative Maintenance with Mimic Tech and no E.B.S. disclosure or tribunals, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Mimic Tech docility is Phase Four; Seven and Eight are disclosure and stabilization, not endless maintenance.

options.label: B
options.text: Only the first secret neutralization of a few local officials with no global purge culmination role, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: Early covert removals are prior phases; Seven and Eight are the culmination and physical resolution of the purge.

options.label: C
options.text: The culmination and physical resolution of The Great Purge, systematically dismantling the parasitic control structure of this realm.
options.rationale: Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent the culmination and physical resolution of The Great Purge, systematically dismantling the parasitic control structure of this realm.

options.label: D
options.text: Only a cancelled operation that never transitions the public from controlled ignorance to realization, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: Together these phases transition the public from controlled ignorance into full realization of hijack and liberation.

questions.hint: Place them as culmination and physical resolution after earlier covert removals.

questions.question: How does Phase Seven fracture the 3D illusion?

options.label: A
options.text: Only through quiet newspaper editorials with no Emergency Broadcast System activation at all and no hidden harvest architecture behind the scenes.
options.rationale: Phase Seven is defined by global E.B.S. activation, not quiet editorials alone.

options.label: B
options.text: Through global activation of the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System) that initiates the definitive psychological fracture of the 3D illusion.
options.rationale: Phase Seven initiates the definitive psychological fracture of the 3D illusion through global activation of the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System).

options.label: C
options.text: Only by delaying all disclosure until after Ascension with no 3D-illusion fracture step, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Phase Seven is the disclosure fracture stage before Phase Eight stabilization and Ascension prep.

options.label: D
options.text: Only by restoring mainstream media narrative control without any truth broadcast takeover, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Phase Seven seizes media and internet to broadcast truth, severing previous narrative control.

questions.hint: Name the global system activated for definitive psychological fracture.

questions.question: What is Phase Eight’s primary role after the E.B.S. blow?

options.label: A
options.text: Only soft reassurance ads with no tribunals, arrests, or realm security function, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Phase Eight includes tribunals, arrests, executions, and realm security—not soft ads alone.

options.label: B
options.text: Nothing beyond permanent Mimic Tech continuity so neutralized elites appear forever without justice, and no coordinated multi-system design behind it.
options.rationale: Phase Eight publicly confirms arrests, confessions, and executions rather than endless Mimic continuity.

options.label: C
options.text: Only restarting Phase One covert removals as if disclosure never happened publicly in any density, cycle, or historical configuration.
options.rationale: Phase Eight is aftermath stabilization after public disclosure, not a restart of Phase One secrecy.

options.label: D
options.text: Immediate aftermath and stabilization, executing justice through tribunals and permanently securing the realm for upcoming Ascension processes.
options.rationale: Phase Eight is the immediate aftermath and stabilization period, executing justice through tribunals and permanently securing the realm for upcoming Ascension processes.

questions.hint: Connect aftermath, tribunals, and securing the realm for Ascension.

questions.question: What transition do these final phases create for the public?

options.label: A
options.text: From controlled ignorance into full, undeniable realization of the planetary hijack and its subsequent liberation.
options.rationale: These final phases transition the public from controlled ignorance into full, undeniable realization of the planetary hijack and its subsequent liberation.

options.label: B
options.text: From Ascension completion backward into underground trafficking reconstruction, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Phase Three dismantled underground networks earlier; final phases secure liberation and Ascension prep.

options.label: C
options.text: From full liberation back into deeper controlled ignorance with no hijack realization allowed, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The direction is out of controlled ignorance into realization of hijack and liberation.

options.label: D
options.text: From Trigger Events scare alone into permanent war with no truth packages or tribunals, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Trigger Events prepare Sleepers; Seven and Eight deliver truth packages and justice stabilization.

questions.hint: Move from controlled ignorance to undeniable realization of hijack and liberation.

questions.question: How is The Great Purge defined across the full sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: Only permanent protection of banking heads and media moguls with no neutralization stages, while spiritual attention and institutional trust stay fully intact.
options.rationale: Dangerous entities including banking heads and media moguls were neutralized in covert stages before Seven and Eight.

options.label: B
options.text: Systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, culminating in mass public awakening.
options.rationale: The Great Purge is the systematic, top-down removal of the parasitic control structure, beginning with global leaders and moving through infrastructure, culminating in mass public awakening.

options.label: C
options.text: Only a bottom-up street protest with no top-down leader removal or infrastructure sweep, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The purge is top-down from leaders through infrastructure, not only bottom-up protest.

options.label: D
options.text: Nothing beyond a single media interview with no multi-phase dismantling of parasitic control, and no coordinated multi-system design behind it.
options.rationale: It is a multi-tiered operation culminating in mass public awakening through phased removal.

questions.hint: Describe top-down removal from leaders through infrastructure to mass awakening.

questions.question: What defines Phase Seven as the disclosure stage?

options.text: Only Mimic Tech replacements with no seizure of narrative channels for disclosure, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Mimic Tech is Phase Four continuity; Phase Seven is public E.B.S. disclosure seizure.

options.label: B
options.text: Benevolent forces seize total control of global media and internet to broadcast undeniable proof of elite crimes.
options.rationale: Phase Seven is the disclosure stage where benevolent forces seize total control of global media and internet to broadcast undeniable proof of elite crimes.

options.label: C
options.text: Only private courtroom notes with no global media and internet takeover in the public eye, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Communications takeover is complete and public; broadcasts run as continuous truth packages.

options.label: D
options.text: Benevolent forces permanently restore corporate media ownership with no elite-crime broadcasts, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Phase Seven seizes media to expose elite crimes, not restore corporate narrative ownership.

questions.hint: Focus on seizure of media and internet to broadcast proof of elite crimes.

options.label: B

options.rationale: Soft truths begin Phase Seven broadcasts; Phase Eight executes tribunals, arrests, and executions.

options.label: C
options.text: Public and private tribunals, arrests, and executions of neutralized parasites to prepare the realm for reconstruction.
options.rationale: Phase Eight is the aftermath and stabilization period involving public and private tribunals, arrests, and executions of neutralized parasites to prepare the realm for reconstruction.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Project Blue Beam sky shows with no realm reconstruction preparation function and no hidden harvest architecture behind the scenes.
options.rationale: Blue Beam is a Phase Five/Six scare tool; Phase Eight prepares reconstruction after justice.

questions.hint: List tribunals, arrests, executions, and reconstruction prep.

options.text: Only a corporate ad network that strengthens the 3D illusion without exposing parasites, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: E.B.S. dismantles the 3D illusion and exposes the parasite system under Whitehat control.

options.label: D
options.text: A continuous 72-plus hour global broadcast of truth packages designed to dismantle the 3D illusion and expose the parasite system.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is a continuous 72-plus hour global broadcast of truth packages designed to dismantle the 3D illusion and expose the parasite system.

questions.hint: Recall continuous multi-day truth packages that dismantle the 3D illusion.
